title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E13 — Bill Russell, Johnny Cash, June Carter
Flip plays Bill Russell in a game of 1-on-1 (chess, that is) and Geraldine square dances with Johnny Cash.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E14 — Slappy White, Tim Conway
Slappy does stand-up; sketches include Pink Pirate (Conway) w/castaways (Flip & Slappy) and a convoluted con game.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E15 — James Coco, Barbara McNair, Jim Nabors
Coco, Nabors & Flip do theater parody; Freddie Johnson shops for a card and Geraldine battles McNair to be queen of a parade.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E17 — Marty Feldman, Howard Cosell, Sandy Duncan
Marty Feldman battles the Beast In The Basket and Howard Cosell judges Sandy & Flip's cakes in the county fair bake-off.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E21 — Della Reese, George Carlin, Roy Clark
Carlin & Flip report the news; Carlin does a monologue on race & society and the cast does a comic courtroom scene.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E22 — Rich Little, Ed McMahon, Cicely Tyson
Cast does a Tonight Show spoof with Rich as Johnny Carson; Flip & Cicely’s honeymoon gets disrupted by dentists.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E2 — Monty Hall, Sandy Duncan, William Windom, The Pointer Sisters
Cast does prop skits; Windom does a dramatic scene and Sandy, the Pointers & Geraldine join Monty on Let's Make A Deal.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E3 — Richard Pryor, Ralph Edwards, Bobby Sandler
Richard Pryor does stand-up and joins Flip for sketches including This Is Your Life Geraldine Jones hosted by Ralph Edwards.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E4 — Joan Rivers, Redd Foxx, Helen Reddy
Guests trade off doing bench skits with Flip; Redd provides inspiration for an artist (Flip) and Joan Rivers does brilliant stand-up.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E5 — Burns & Schreiber, Harry Belafonte
Guests do interpretive skits with a glass; Burns & Schreiber do a human computer bit and Belafonte shills for a huckster (Flip).

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E6 — Robert Goulet, Carol Lawrence, Slappy White
Flip jokes about karate; Slappy White does stand-up and a soft shoe dance joining the whole cast for a burlesque segment.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E7 — Henry 'Hank' Aaron, Lee Grant, Gladys Knight, Andrew Johnson
Lee shoots a commercial; baseball great Hank Aaron does Q&A then is the subject of a testimonial dinner sketch with the full cast.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E8 — Tim Conway, Richard Pryor
Flip, Conway & Pryor do interpretive prop sketches with a chair; Flip counsels lazy friend Calvin (Pryor).

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E12 — Jack Klugman, Roscoe Lee Browne, Franklyn Ajaye, Anthony Newley
Browne & Newley are British secret agents; Franklyn Ajaye does stand-up and Klugman's a football referee in slow motion.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E3 — Raymond Burr, Ruth Gordon, Stevie Wonder
Flip, Ruth & Raymond attend the opera; Stevie plays a synthesizer as Flip recites a poem and Ruth visits Charley’s Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E4 — Ruth Buzzi, Tim Conway
Flip, Tim & Ruth do a park bench skit and private eye spoof; Geraldine disrupts the office at her new job.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E21 — Independence Day
It’s Moesha’s 18th birthday, and as a surprise, her family and friends unknowingly invite all of Moesha’s past boyfriends to the party.
